name: statblock
description: Creature stat block. Temporary M1 definition: fields move into a system plugin in M6.

attributes.name: system
attributes.description: Id of the system plugin that defines the fields.

name: layout
description: Changes the page template for every following page. It always starts a new page.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The page template, defined by the theme.

name: figure
description: An image in the text, with an optional caption. One column wide, or spanning all columns. It never splits: it moves whole to the next column or page.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: The image: the file name (or id) of an image added to the project.

attributes.name: alt
attributes.description: What the image shows, for people who cannot see it.

attributes.name: span
attributes.description: column: as wide as the column it is in. all: across all the columns of the page.

name: page
description: One special page, then the flow returns to the current layout. It always starts a new page.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: art-full: the image fills the whole page, with no header or footer; the page number is drawn over it. art-top, art-bottom: a band of art across the top or the bottom of the page, and the text that follows flows in the rest of it.

attributes.name: art
attributes.description: The image: the file name (or id) of an image added to the project.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: For art-top and art-bottom: how tall the band is, as a length (90mm, 3in) or a percentage of the page height (40%). The theme sets a default.

attributes.name: side
attributes.description: left: the page is a left-hand page, with a blank page before it when it would otherwise be a right-hand one. For two pages of art that face each other, give it to the first.

name: toc
description: A table of contents, made from the headings of the whole book when it is exported, with the page number of each. It takes the room of a page or two where it is written.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The heading shown above the list.

attributes.name: depth
attributes.description: How many heading levels are listed: 1 is the chapter titles (#), 2 adds the ## headings, 3 adds ###.
